works: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas

ownDescription: An archipelago of cities clinging to warm air currents. You sail there by reading the wind, and those who can read it hold the trade routes. For two generations a music has risen from the depths at night and nobody knows where it comes from. Families who have lost a pilot wear a knotted cord at the wrist. There are neither firearms nor horses, and metal is so scarce that it serves as currency.

A single city under a winter that has lasted forty years. Heat comes from deep wells that nobody knows how to dig any more, and whoever controls a well controls a quarter. Births are rare and celebrated for eight days. They say something lives under the ice that answers when you knock three times. The dead are not buried, they are given back to the cold.

The kingdom of Valderon spreads over three valleys. Queen Maelis has reigned there from the citadel of Gorn, and the clans of the North dispute her right to levy the tax. The river Aldre separates the tilled lands from the marshes where those called the nameless live. Since the last flood the harvests no longer hold and the citadel rations. No one crosses the marshes after nightfall.
